L26: ## Abstract
L27: 
L28: Consider ℜ_{ n }— the linear space of all linear transformations on an n-dimensional space. The trace t(A) defined for A ϵ ℜ_{ n } is a complex valued linear functional whose characteristic properties are simple and well known. Moreover τ(A) = t([A]) defines a norm on ℜ_{ n }. An extension of these facts is being presented in the discussion which follows.
